scope: Read-only CLI capability inspection; no container started
requires_qualification: Use only an owner-approved isolated builder and pinned pre-existing image
Verify network access is denied from the actual build container, including DNS and HTTP negative controls
Pre-stage and verify the complete source inventory, tools and base image before network isolation
Verify mounted sockets, host network and other host proxies cannot bypass the intended boundary
Retain source resolution, checksums, workload logs, installed probes and physical backing storage evidence
